slate_notes: Morning snapshot. 8 legs across 6 games: NFL MNF x2 (both BAL unders, same game, don't put both in one slip), NBA 3PM x3 (GS@NO, POR@MIN, ORL@BOS), NHL SOG x3 (MTL@NYR x2 on opposite teams, VAN@UTA). No college props. Every est_prob is a multiplicative two-way devig at the exact half-point line using WinDaily best-of-book prices (stamped 9:00 AM ET), shaded down 1.5-3.5 pts. Average est_prob 0.593. Excluded games: HOU@MIA, MEM@WSH, PHX@DEN had no props posted yet, and CHI@CLE/PHI@BKN had only thin one-book markets. Dropped despite good prices because the game logs contradicted them: Zion O2.5 ast (over only 4/10), McDaniels U3.5 ast (over 6/10), Hampton U1.5 rec (2+ in 5/8), Saddiq Bey U2.5 3PM (usage up with Murphy/Murray out), DeBrusk U2.5 SOG, Camara U2.5 3PM, Trocheck O0.5 pts. Also dropped Kuminga/Cissoko/Avdija 3PM because a hold under 2% suggests stale best-of-book quotes. PrizePicks/Underdog app lines are UNCONFIRMED.
